name: tito10047/geocoder
description: Self-hosted geocoder and address autocomplete built from OpenStreetMap data on Meilisearch, without a framework

suggest.ext-intl: Compares names of every script without diacritics and case (the built-in fallback covers the European Latin alphabets)
suggest.ext-zstd: Reads the zstd-compressed Photon dumps without running the zstd command
